name: bakoma-revived-prototype
description: Experimental live LaTeX preview with token provenance and a LuaTeX checkpoint backend.

bakoma.python.description: Retained for legacy comparison tools. Open Experimental Preview always uses the C++ backend.
bakoma.python.deprecationMessage: Retained for legacy comparison tools. Open Experimental Preview always uses the C++ backend.

bakoma.engine.description: Open Experimental Preview always uses C++ and the live LuaHBTeX compiler.
bakoma.engine.deprecationMessage: Open Experimental Preview always uses C++ and the live LuaHBTeX compiler.

bakoma.mainFile.description: Main .tex path relative to the workspace, or absolute. Empty discovers the active document, its % !TEX root comment, main.tex, or prompts.

bakoma.previewMode.description: Open Experimental Preview always starts live compilation, regardless of this legacy setting.
bakoma.previewMode.deprecationMessage: Open Experimental Preview always starts live compilation, regardless of this legacy setting.

bakoma.latexCompiler.description: Open Experimental Preview uses its own LuaHBTeX compiler, regardless of prior compiler settings or magic comments.
bakoma.latexCompiler.deprecationMessage: Open Experimental Preview uses its own LuaHBTeX compiler, regardless of prior compiler settings or magic comments.

bakoma.projectRoot.description: Directory containing the main document and shared project assets. Relative to the workspace (or main-file directory without a workspace). Empty uses the containing workspace folder, otherwise the main-file directory.
